# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser canvas game titled **Midnight Wanted: Bloodline Survival**. Preserve the source mechanics: bounded open-world free roam, joystick/keyboard movement, a pickup button for nearby loot, an attack button with frontal arc damage, enemies that chase and damage on contact, three health units, score for kills, persistent 60-item collection index, game-over and restart/menu flow. Reinterpret the world as a satirical gothcore vampire city inspired by open-world crime parody and survival game energy: the player is a tiny vampire runaway after a cursed sleepover, collecting contraband drip/lore drops while glitch patrols close in. Use procedural neon alleys, analog-horror scanlines, bat/vampire silhouette, meme-tone HUD vocabulary, catalog-approved horror fonts/audio, and mobile-safe controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Reality
- genre: mobile-first free-roam canvas survival action game.
- objective: roam a bounded open world, collect nearby item drops, use held items or bare attack to defeat pursuing enemies, grow score, and survive with three hit points.
- input model: left virtual joystick or WASD/arrow movement; LOOT/claim and BONK/attack buttons or keyboard equivalents.
- core loop: start run, move through 2500x2500 world, pick up spawned loot, enemies chase, attack arc damages enemies, defeated enemies add score and may drop loot, contact removes health, game over at zero health, restart/menu/index available.
- fail/friction state: repeated enemy contact drains three hearts; no hard win state, survival score and collection index are progression signals.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve player speed, friction, bounded world, camera follow, enemy pursuit, spawn caps/timers, item pickup radius, attack cooldown/reach/damage semantics, score-on-kill, HP/contact damage, collection persistence, start/index/game-over/restart state flow.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/copy, entity silhouettes, procedural background, item names/icons/colors, audio mapping, fonts, panels, joystick/button styling, particle colors, and progression framing are presentational and safe to transform while preserving the loop.
